senses.gloss: סִילֵּת (denom. of סֹלֶת) to sift, select, produce fine flour.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 11:5">Ter. XI, 5</cite> <he>המְסַלֵּת קב וכ׳</he> he who gets one or two Kab out of one S’ah of wheat. Y. ib. 47ᵈ bot. <he>מסלת בחטים וכ׳</he> the priest may sift out of the (flour of) wheat (of T’rumah) as much as he wants (and abandon the rest). Tanḥ. T’tsavveh 5 <he>וסַלֵּית לי מתוכה וכ׳</he> and get me out of it flour for one loaf (v. <cite ref="C00907"><he>גְּלוּסְקָא</he></cite>) fine and well sifted.—Part. pass. <he>מְסוּלָּת</he>, pl. <he>מְסוּלָּתִים</he>.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 21">Sifré Deut. 21</cite> <he>מן … מן המס׳ שבכם</he> out of the chosen, out of the select among you, v. <cite ref="B01207"><he>בָּרוּר</he></cite>.
